comment: Source read at commit 21bfcbf, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.0. THE PTTERN INPUT IS DEAD: RomanQuantizer.cpp:403 configures it and nothing in process() ever reads it, so the sequence can only be changed with the knob. The maker's README lists 'Pattrn: Switch between different sequences' without saying which control, and the jack's own tooltip reads 'Pattern', which is why it gets a line saying so rather than being left untagged. The sixteen chord squares are ChordWidget displays with no ParamWidget, so they have no census position and no note; the same is true of the key display under the KEY knob.
